#define TIMER_CTRL_REG 0x00u
#define TIMER_CTRL_ENABLE_MASK GENMASK(0, 0)
#define TIMER_CTRL_ENABLE_SHIFT 0
#define TIMER_CTRL_ENABLE_BIT BIT(0)
#define TIMER_CTRL_IRQ_EN_MASK GENMASK(1, 1)
void timer_program(void __iomem *base) { uint32_t reg = readl(base + TIMER_CTRL_REG); reg |= FIELD_PREP(TIMER_CTRL_ENABLE_MASK, 1); writel(reg, base + TIMER_CTRL_REG); }
